description: This file is a test script for setting the 6GHz Wi-Fi radio's STBC Enable setting via the HAL API wifi_setRadioSTBCEnable(). It uses the TDK scripting library and wifiUtility for interaction with the Wi-Fi hardware abstraction layer, executes a test step to set the parameter, and reports success or failure.

classes.name: tdklib.TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: A wrapper class for TDK scripting library to facilitate test case execution.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Utility method to retrieve the index of the specified radio ('6G') from the device.
